title: BioShock 2
shortDescription: BioShock 2 helps define a PC (Windows) shooter path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Keeps a documented shooter option visible in the PC (Windows) collection.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the PC (Windows) shooter discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
